season.evidence: Mountaineers route page and WTA/yellowleaf-style reports point to snow-free summer and early fall for the Hester Lake line, with the standard gully route kept for snow months; Peakbagger ascents on this peak are overwhelmingly Dec-May snow trips, so only the Oct 1 2023 ascent is near the window.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Oct 1 2023, summited, complete round trip from the trailhead, but it climbs by bushwhacking the northeast ridge over Point 4892 and only descends toward Little Hester Lake; our route gains the east ridge from the boulder field south of the lake. Logged name 'Hester Lake to NE Ridge' does not settle which of our routes it is.
November 2022 and not a complete round trip.
August 2008 summit, but no trip detail or track checks for identity.

facts.text: In early October the shaded boulder slope south of Little Hester Lake is coated in wet moss and slick underfoot.
In early October, running water can be found beneath the boulders a few hundred feet above Little Hester Lake, a handy refill before the long walk out.

notes: Almost all Peakbagger ascents of Price are winter/spring snow trips from the standard gully, off-season for the stored routes. The only route with a trailhead pin is Hester Lake Route (Dingford Creek; tracks start about 120 m from it, fine). Lower Ramp, Prominent Dihedral, Northeast and South Ridge are empty stubs; some may be the same line as another stub or the Hester route.
